case_scope: United Kingdom Child Trust Fund as a starter-asset claim-finality subsystem case

starter_asset_claim_finality.note: Accounts and balances are real, but large numbers of matured accounts remain unclaimed.

claim_conversion_friction.note: Claimants may need to find providers and navigate tracing routes before usable receipt.

benefit_take_up_gap.note: Unclaimed matured accounts show incomplete take-up at maturity.

intergenerational_opportunity_and_person.note: Government-seeded accounts support social inheritance, but claim finality and progressive adequacy require scoring.

auto_enrollment_and_renewal_stability.note: HMRC-created accounts were a fail-safe, but long-run tracing and contact maintenance remained weak.

intermediation_fee_leakage.note: Need evidence on provider fees, third-party tracing fees, and scam exposure around unclaimed accounts.

proof_debt: maturity claim rates by income care status region disability and household form
share of accounts requiring assisted tracing

opening_package.rail_lane: provider registry and automatic maturity notification
opening_package.hardening_lane: progressive top-ups and no-fee claim routes
opening_package.monitoring_lane: unclaimed matured accounts, tracing success, subgroup claim rates, fees, and scams

reopening_triggers: unclaimed matured accounts fall sharply after outreach
evidence shows lower-income or care-experienced youth underclaim
provider fees or third-party claims extraction rises
new automatic payout or default transfer rules are adopted

threshold_moments.why: The account may help at age 18 only if actually found and controlled.

conversion_rails.why: Large unclaimed balances prevent a pass for claim finality.

public_counterweight.why: Public seed supports social inheritance but is cohort-limited and small relative to housing/education thresholds.

evidence_debt_register.question: Which young people are least likely to claim matured accounts?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: HMRC/provider claim rates by deprivation, care status, disability, region, and household instability

evidence_debt_register.question: How much value is lost to provider fees, dormancy, or paid tracing?

validation_notes: Subsystem case; should be compared with Alaska dividend and U.S. starter-account design.
